scene: One small welcoming two-storey home with warm cream walls, a simple terracotta pitched roof, sage front door and four plain pale-blue windows. A tiny rounded shrub beside the door is enough. Gentle front three-quarter view, clear HOME silhouette, no clock or school features, no tiled roof detail, numbers, signs, path or full neighborhood.
